infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Siu Tim Siu Dai uses the camera so you can photograph a meal to estimate its calories and nutrients, photograph your kitchen to list the ingredients you have in stock, or scan a product barcode to look up its nutrition. A meal photo is saved with that entry in your food diary; a pantry photo is not saved; a barcode is read on your device and no image of it is stored or sent anywhere.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Siu Tim Siu Dai accesses your photo library so you can pick an existing meal photo instead of taking a new one. The photo you choose is analysed to estimate calories and nutrients, and is saved with that entry in your food diary.

plugins.cameraPermission: Siu Tim Siu Dai uses the camera so you can photograph a meal to estimate its calories and nutrients, photograph your kitchen to list the ingredients you have in stock, or scan a product barcode to look up its nutrition. A meal photo is saved with that entry in your food diary; a pantry photo is not saved; a barcode is read on your device and no image of it is stored or sent anywhere.

plugins.photosPermission: Siu Tim Siu Dai accesses your photo library so you can pick an existing meal photo instead of taking a new one. The photo you choose is analysed to estimate calories and nutrients, and is saved with that entry in your food diary.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Siu Tim Siu Dai uses Face ID to sign you back in to your account without typing your password. Face ID only unlocks the sign-in token already stored in this device's keychain. Your face data stays on the device, is handled entirely by iOS, and is never sent to us.

plugins.microphonePermission: Siu Tim Siu Dai uses the microphone so you can say “next” or “back” to move between recipe steps while your hands are busy cooking. Your voice is used only to recognise these commands and no recording is saved or sent to us.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Siu Tim Siu Dai uses speech recognition to understand simple cooking commands like “next” and “back” so you can move through recipe steps hands-free. Your speech is interpreted to detect these commands only and is not stored by us.
